_comment: The network wire vocabulary Dart sends and both natives understand. Compared with Dart (test/network_drift_test.dart), with the Java/ObjC sources (same test) and with the REAL SDK enums and constants (NetworkWireParityTest.java, BGSFlutterNetworkOpsTests.m).
